A '''hepatizon spear''' is the [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] [[spear]], made by smithing a [[copper spear]] with [[hepatizon alloy]]. It carries {{MCW|Lunge}} III.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the copper item carry over.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|3}} damage at an attack speed of 1.18 and has 1000 durability. While held in the main hand it adds 0.0105 to movement speed, 10.5% of the player's base speed.

=== Intrinsics ===
Lunge III is stored on the item and applied when it enters a player's inventory.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[hepatizon alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/hepatizon_spear.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* Hepatizon tools reuse the stone tools' item IDs, so they cannot be melted down in a blast furnace.
